description: PostgreSQL stores related data in tables and provides SQL tools for asking questions. Learn a small book table, safe changes and a few PostgreSQL features such as JSONB and useful returned values. Use PostgreSQL in a new practice database through psql or a database editor. These are PostgreSQL examples, not SQLite. They do not run in this site's SQL playground. Use only sample data.
versionNote: Uses PostgreSQL 16+ core SQL, identity columns, JSONB and window functions.
whatYouWillLearn: Learn to explain which rule prevents a negative page count
Learn to ask for the two longest books instead
Learn to read the pages field and notice the text result
learningObjectives: Learn to explain which rule prevents a negative page count
